name: Vana Belle
insider_take: Vana Belle is a sanctuary of Thai elegance where the Gulf of Thailand laps at your doorstep — a place where Luxury Collection storytelling meets the soul of Koh Samui.
whats_special: Nestled along the pristine shores of Chaweng Noi Beach, Vana Belle is one of Koh Samui's most intimate luxury escapes. The resort draws deeply on Thai culture, featuring traditional Siamese architecture, lush tropical gardens, and a collection of pool villas and suites that frame breathtaking Gulf of Thailand views. Its name — "Vana Belle" — blends Sanskrit and French, meaning "Beautiful Forest," a fitting nod to its lush, verdant setting. As part of Marriott's prestigious STARS program under The Luxury Collection, guests enjoy access to elite travel amenities and bespoke services that go far beyond the ordinary.
pro_tip: Book a villa with a private infinity pool facing the Gulf — sunrise here is absolutely spectacular. Ask the concierge to arrange a traditional Thai longtail boat excursion to nearby Koh Tan island for an off-the-beaten-path afternoon adventure.
dont_miss: Don't miss the resort's Vana Spa , where ancient Thai healing rituals are performed using locally sourced botanicals. Also, Koh Samui's iconic Big Buddha Temple (Wat Phra Yai) is just minutes away — a cultural landmark well worth an early morning visit before the crowds arrive.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on pristine Chaweng Noi Beach
Elegant Thai-inspired architecture and sophisticated design
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with traditional treatments
Multiple dining venues featuring authentic Thai and international cuisine
cons: Remote island location requires additional travel planning
